title: Low-stock alerts on the kitchen screen
summary: The kitchen screen shows a red badge when an ingredient is below the minimum set for it.
steps: Set a minimum for each ingredient.
sees: A red badge on the kitchen screen for each ingredient whose daily count is below its minimum.
Each minimum applies only to the ingredient it was set for.
notes: Only the kitchen manager and her two assistants can change a minimum.
The alert uses the daily count already entered, so it can be a day late.
Where and how a minimum is set is not specified yet.
